description: Scrape public YouTube channels, playlists, and search results: one row per video with title, rounded views, relative date, and length, and a row per channel with subscribers, total views, and links. It does not open single video pages. No YouTube login.

channel_tab.description: Which channel list to read: videos (default), shorts, or streams.

include_channel_row.description: yes (default) adds one row per channel source with subscribers, total views, video count, joined date, country, and links. no skips it.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Reports are always delivered.

max_videos_per_source.description: Per channel, playlist, or search term. Default 30, maximum 5000. Set 0 on a channel to get only its channel row.

search_terms.description: Terms to search on YouTube. Each term returns videos in YouTube's order, for a logged out US visitor. Clay users: wrap a column in a one item list.

urls.description: Channel, @handle, playlist, or search result addresses, or a bare channel ID or @handle. Up to 200 sources a run, counted with search terms. A single video address returns one free row: this actor does not open video pages. Clay users: wrap a column in a one item list.

name: scrape_youtube_videos_channels
title: Scrape YouTube videos and channels
